skill.name: personwise-partner-training
skill.description: Build source-grounded partner and reseller training as an interactive PersonWise digital-human course with controlled publishing and review checkpoints.
skill.summary: Create interactive partner training from approved program materials.
skill.author: personwiseai

security_audit.summary: Two hardcoded release URLs are confirmed network and software supply-chain risks, while shell substitutions, Markdown backticks, installer safeguards, and signed descriptor entropy are false positives. Semantic review found third-party executable installation, server-supplied update commands, external document uploads, and implicit course-credit consumption.

remediation.issue: The skill can install and run a third-party executable that is not reviewable in the package.
remediation.suggestion: Require separate informed confirmation before installation, disclose the publisher and destination, and require native code signatures in addition to pinned hashes.

remediation.issue: The workflow executes an update command supplied by an external service response.
remediation.suggestion: Parse updates into an allowlisted command and argument structure, verify signed release metadata locally, and reject unexpected executable paths or flags.

remediation.issue: Selected partner documents are treated as authorized for external upload.
remediation.suggestion: Before each upload, name the destination service and exact files, then obtain explicit confirmation for the transfer.

remediation.issue: A creation request implicitly authorizes consumption of existing course credits.
remediation.suggestion: Show the credit cost and obtain explicit confirmation before creating each course or consuming any limited account credit.

content.value_statement: Partner teams need consistent onboarding without unsupported commercial claims. This skill builds a source-grounded, interactive PersonWise course with review checkpoints, access controls, and learner questions.
actual_capabilities: Creates interactive PersonWise courses from approved partner program materials.
Structures lessons around partnership value, product narrative, deal flow, approved claims, and escalation paths.
Uploads user-selected source documents and monitors their processing status.
Reviews outline and script checkpoints for factual support, coverage, consistency, and repetition.
Supports conceptual visuals, presenter guidance, source-grounded questions, and optional assessments.
Publishes private or link-access courses and reports the verified access URL.
limitations: Requires PersonWise CLI 1.1.6 or newer, browser OAuth, an eligible account, and available course credits.
Uses an external PersonWise service and may upload selected documents outside the local environment.
Cannot validate commercial, legal, or contractual claims beyond the supplied approved materials.
Cannot claim learner competence, external certification, platform approval, or real-world completion.

use_cases.title: Onboard new channel partners
use_cases.description: Turn approved program documents into a private course covering product messaging, deal registration, handoffs, branding rules, and escalation contacts.

use_cases.title: Train reseller teams
use_cases.description: Create a concise reseller course with approved customer narratives, self-check questions, and clear boundaries for commercial claims.

use_cases.title: Publish a controlled program update
use_cases.description: Revise an existing course from current materials, review every checkpoint, and release it with the requested access mode.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic partner course
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a private partner training course from [materials]. Teach [audience] the product story, deal flow, approved claims, and escalation path.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner course creation from approved materials

prompt_templates.title: Ground a course in documents
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a [page count]-page partner onboarding course using only [documents]. Preserve approved terminology and route unsupported commercial questions to [partner team].
prompt_templates.scenario: Materials-only onboarding with strict factual grounding

prompt_templates.title: Add assessment and visual direction
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a private reseller course from [materials] for [audience]. Include [assessment type], conceptual deal-flow visuals, and an interactive presenter brief.
prompt_templates.scenario: Structured training with assessment and presentation requirements

prompt_templates.title: Review and publish an existing course
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume course [project ID]. Verify every source is ready, review outline and script checkpoints, correct unsupported claims, then publish with [access mode].
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced recovery, quality review, and controlled publishing

output_examples.input: Create a five-page private onboarding course from our partner handbook.
output: Resolved format: five-page private partner onboarding course.
Teaching arc: partnership, product story, deal flow, approved claims, and escalation.
Evidence: supplied handbook only, with unsupported commercial questions routed to the partner team.

output_examples.input: Turn our reseller guide into training with a short knowledge check.
output: Course structure: reseller value, customer narrative, handoff process, branding limits, and support contacts.
Knowledge check: scenario questions based only on approved guide content.
Delivery: interactive presenter with source-grounded learner questions.

output_examples.input: Update the existing course and give partners a shareable link.
output_examples.output: The course was reviewed against current sources, updated at supported fields, published with link access, and checked for playability.

best_practices: Provide current, approved partner materials and identify the factual authority for commercial claims.
Specify the audience, desired page count, assessment needs, language, and access mode before creation.
Review each outline, script, and image checkpoint before advancing or publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not invent commissions, margins, territories, lead flows, legal status, earnings, portals, or tier structures.
Do not upload agent-discovered files or images without explicit approval.
Do not call private editor links shareable or describe Topics submissions as approved.

faq.question: What materials should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide approved partner handbooks, product messaging, deal-flow guidance, branding rules, and escalation contacts relevant to the course.

faq.question: Can the skill work only from supplied documents?
faq.answer: Yes. Select materials-only mode to restrict the course to uploaded documents and preserve every selected source.

faq.question: Can learners ask questions during the course?
faq.answer: Yes. The PersonWise digital human supports voice questions grounded in the course and its approved source material.

faq.question: Does the skill publish courses automatically?
faq.answer: It follows the requested access target. Private is the default when no target is specified, and broader access requires user authorization.

faq.question: Does course creation use account credits?
faq.answer: Yes. A new course requires available PersonWise course credits, and the workflow checks readiness before creation.

faq.question: Can it certify partner readiness?
faq.answer: No. Assessments can check understanding, but the skill cannot claim certification, competence, approval, or real-world completion.
